damage_zone: southeast high-bay roof, rear staging and fourth truck dock
environment_layer: continuous gravel and masonry rubble beneath the failed roof corner
fallen full-block roof and dock members across the fourth staging lane
scrap and refuse concentrated in the damaged trailer-court corner
weathered employee parking, truck apron and utility court
occupation_layer: industrial loot retained in the surviving western staging lane
pillagers occupying the protected upper corporate offices
invariants: public entrance, both office floors and office stair survive
quality-control access and central warehouse cross aisle remain navigable
three western truck docks retain staging approaches
maintenance room and independent east exit survive
damage remains localized to the southeast structural failure
